text_en: Soldier, after everything we've done to get home...
No, brave warriors. Your world is not yet lost.
Your mission is to defeat the Infestation.
Gather all the troops you can and fight until the end.
You mortals always find the strength. I have seen it thousands of times.
They will not break us so easily.
We will not give up without a fight.
They will not be rid of us without first seeing what we are.
